text:
maya: heads up — after last night's driver rollout in us-west-2 we're seeing a spike of inference pod crashes. tensorRT/xformers plugins failing to load on multiple nodes.

kyle: copying logs? which error?

maya: pasted one from an affected pod:```
2026-03-18T01:12:03Z ERROR load_plugin: failed to open plugin libflashattention.so: /usr/local/lib/libcudart.so.11.0: version `CUDART_11_7' not found
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  TRT engine creation failed: symbol lookup error: undefined symbol: _ZN9flashattn...
```

samir: that looks like a CUDA/driver ABI mismatch. we pushed 525.xx -> 530.xx last night, some nodes rebooted, some didn't (kube drained mid-update). mixed drivers + cached compiled kernels = undefined symbols. also seeing libnccl version mismatches in other logs.

leah: are these nodes homogeneous by image? could be old liveness probe bringing back containers onto nodes that never finished driver install.

maya: verified — node labels show a handful still on 525 while most moved to 530. scheduler ended up packing inference pods onto the old nodes because of GPU fragmentation.

devops-bot: Alert: inference-pool-usw2: GPU_FAIL_RATE > 8% (5m) — affected pods: 42 — impacted routes: /generate-chat (p95 latency up).

zoe: immediate mitigation: can we cordon the old-driver nodes and drain them (force) so pods land on consistent-driver nodes? risk: capacity drop, will OOM/spill to CPU for some heavy workloads.

andre: quick check — some TensorRT engines were compiled with vendor plugin linked against cudart 11.7 symbols. 530 driver exposes newer ABI; 525 doesn't, so direction matters. If pods hit older driver nodes they fail at load. simplest short-term is to pin scheduling away from mixed nodes and use instance pool with pinned 530 nodes.

kyle: commands to run:```
kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o wide | grep -E "525|530"
kubectl cordon <old-node> && kubectl drain <old-node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

maya: started cordoning 3 nodes (usw2-gpu-10..12). draining now. moving traffic to dedicated reserved capacity in us-east-1 for the hot path to keep SLAs.

samir: long-term: revert the driver rollout for the canary-sized pool until we finish rebuilding TensorRT/flashattn plugins against the new cudart/driver, OR rebuild wheels (xformers+flashattn) with unified CUDA toolchain and run a staged canary. we need a rollout doc that ties driver version -> plugin build matrix.

leah: agree — also add a kube-scheduler predicate to avoid mixed-driver scheduling during rollouts, and add a check in the driver upgrader to confirm all nodes rebooted successfully before removing old-label.

andre: cost note — shifting inference to east region will incur cross-region egress + temporary OnDemand use of reserved pools. estimate additional $4-6k/day if this persists for >24h. ops leadership needs to sign off if >48h.

maya: creating incident ticket and PR for: rollback plan for canary nodes, build/release matrix, scheduler predicate, and an emergency runbook. assigning to samir/andre for driver-plugin compatibility work.

kyle: once drained, monitor GPU_UTIL and pod restarts. if anything still crashes on 530 nodes, we rebuild the TRT engines.

devops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1843 — "us-west-2 inference driver-plugin incompat" — severity: high.

zoe: thanks — I'll coordinate capacity migrations and put a hold on further driver rollouts until we finish canary verification. :thumbsup:

maya: update: drains finished, crashcount dropped 90% in 10m window. keeping this thread open until PRs merged.

samir: adding link to root cause notes and a quick script to detect mixed-driver nodes:```
#!/bin/bash
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o name); do
  ssh $n "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader" | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c
done
```

leah: reminder — add a postmortem section for batching/kv-cache impact while capacity shifted; some customers saw degraded throughput even after crash fixes.

maya: noted. will post timeline + exec summary after incident closed. :raised_hands:
